title: SAP Emarsys (now SAP Engagement Cloud) - Omnichannel marketing automation with AI recommendations
clean_text: SAP Emarsys, rebranded to SAP Engagement Cloud in late 2025, is an omnichannel customer engagement platform offering AI-powered product recommendations through its Predict feature alongside email, SMS, push, and web personalization. Includes 60+ pre-built marketing automation tactics, customer segmentation, and real-time behavioral triggers for abandonment and retargeting. The platform is sold in two editions: Emarsys Edition, a standalone marketing automation platform, and Enterprise Edition, which adds real-time integration with SAP Commerce Cloud, S/4HANA, and Joule AI. Targets mid-to-large retailers, with Enterprise Edition specifically suited to existing SAP CX customers.
